headline: Woolpert Acquires Barcelona-Based Engineering Firm B-Global Tech
summary: Woolpert has acquired B-Global Tech, a Barcelona-based architecture and engineering firm specializing in mission-critical design, expanding its footprint across Europe and Asia-Pacific.
why: Strategic engineering acquisitions enhance technical capabilities and geographic reach for professional consulting and design firms.

impacts.name: Woolpert
impacts.why: Woolpert is expanding its business through the acquisition.
